outcome: Placental uptake and release of proteins
cohort: The study included 75 healthy and 37 preeclamptic mother-fetus pairs (19 early-onset preeclampsia and 18 late-onset preeclampsia) from whom samples were collected.
finding: Maternal sFlt-1 and ET-1 abundance increased with preeclampsia severity, while fetal ET-1 and sFlt-1 were higher in early-onset preeclampsia, and placental release of PlGF and sFlt-1 to the maternal circulation was confirmed across all groups.
